Let $({x}_{m},{y}_{m})$ be the midpoint between ${{(p,-3q)}_{⏟}}_{\text{(}{x}_{1}\text{,}\,{y}_{1})}$ and ${{(-p,7q)}_{⏟}}_{\text{(}{x}_{2}\text{,}\,{y}_{2})}.$

We use the midpoint formula as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}({x}_{m},{y}_{m}) & =(\frac{{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}}{2},\frac{{y}_{1}+{y}_{2}}{2}) \\  & =(\frac{a+5a}{2},\frac{2b+7b}{2}) \\  & =(\frac{6a}{2},\frac{9b}{2}) \\  & =(3a,\frac{9b}{2})\end{aligned}
$$
